notes: Two own pages read, both HTTP 200 and not thin: the pricing page settles every claim, and the home page settles none beyond it. No other own page was needed. C05 (free tier up to 15 users) is wrong: the pricing page gives the free Personal plan 2 users; no own page read dates a change of the free limit, so it is not classed stale. Cause tracing for C05 read six pages cited by the three Claude answers (q3 runs 1 to 3): icertglobal carries the $10.99 price but not the 15-user limit, guideflow says the free plan caps at 10 users, goodday.work carries 'free for up to 15 users' but about GoodDay, not Asana, celoxis and workzone carry no free-plan limit, and medium.com answered HTTP 403 (a person could read it once in a browser to complete the trace). Cause recorded as not found. Not coded: hedged or non-specific plan lines (q1 ChatGPT run 1 'Availability varies by plan', q5 ChatGPT runs 2 and 3 'Some planning features require paid plans/tiers', q3 ChatGPT run 2 'warrant reviewing Enterprise tiers', q7 Google AI Overviews run 2 'often requires higher-tier plans'), the q3 Perplexity run 1 category-wide range ('entry-level plans often start around $7-$11 per user per month for tools like ClickUp, monday.com, and Asana'), mentions of the company name (Asana, Inc.) and feature names (Portfolios, Universal Reporting, Rules, multi-homing), which are names or capabilities, not naming facts. C07 groups Enterprise-only features with two Google AI Overviews lines that say deep capacity planning or resource forecasting needs higher-tier plans. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser snapshots exist for Asana and no claim was unverifiable for a blocked or thin page; the three gap lines (the generic free-trials line, a capability line in q3 Google AI Overviews run 2, the hedged category-wide price range) are out of scope; a scan of every table and Asana sub-heading in the full answers found only prices and plan lines already coded, capabilities and best-for cells (the passing 'enterprise-level quote' in q3 ChatGPT run 3 and 'Prices are in USD' in q1 ChatGPT run 2 were not coded), so no claim or instance was added. Consistency check: C05 stays wrong, since the pricing page states the free Personal plan's limit for the same plan and unit ('2 users collaborate for free'; user limit row '2 seats') with no dated change.
